ns2:course.label: Politics of the Vietnam War
ns2:course.description: Examines questions about the war in Vietnam and the era during which it was fought. Focuses on official policy questions, such as the decision making process, the legality of the war, the question of war crimes, and lessons for international relations. Domestic issues, such as the rise and effect of the antiwar movement, are also discussed. Prerequisite: Allen Hall residency or consent of Unit One director.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Allen Hall residency or consent of Unit One director.
